email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoGlutide patient with chest pain followed by loss of consciousness
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a staff pharmacist at Demo Regional Hospital (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 38-year-old male patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their second dose of DemoGlutide via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-01-24.
Approximately 4 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed chest pain followed by loss of consciousness.
The patient was hospitalized as a result.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
A. Duval (fictional reporter)
Demo Regional Hospital
Contact: demo.reporter651@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
